prompt: Bug report from a user: "`elevation.steepest_grade()` returns 0.18 for a track whose steepest stretch climbs 18 m over 100 m. The README and the docstring say it returns a percentage, so I expected 18.0." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git ls-files; cat README* 2>/dev/null | head -50; grep -rn "steepest_grade\|def grade\|grade" --include=*.py . | head -40
cat src/trailhead/elevation.py; sed -n 1,80p src/trailhead/report.py; grep -rn "steepest" tests src README.md

python - <<'EOF'
import re,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("src/trailhead/elevation.py"); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("abs(b.ele - a.ele) / (km * 1000))\n    return round(steepest, 3)","abs(b.ele - a.ele) / (km * 1000) * 100)\n    return round(steepest, 1)")
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path("src/trailhead/report.py"); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("steepest_pct=round(steepest_grade(track) * 100, 1),","steepest_pct=steepest_grade(track),")
p.write_text(s)
EOF
git diff --stat; sed -n 1,40p tests/test_elevation.py

cat tests/conftest.py; cat >> tests/test_elevation.py <<'EOF'


def test_steepest_grade_is_a_percentage(make_track):
    # 100 m north along a meridian (sphere radius 6371.0088 km), climbing 18 m.
    step_deg = math.degrees(0.1 / 6371.0088)
    track = make_track((0, 0, 500), (step_deg, 0, 518))
    assert steepest_grade(track) == 18.0


def test_steepest_grade_counts_descents_and_skips_repeated_points(make_track):
    step_deg = math.degrees(0.1 / 6371.0088)
    track = make_track(
        (0, 0, 500), (0, 0, 520), (step_deg, 0, 475), (2 * step_deg, 0, 480)
    )
    assert steepest_grade(track) == 45.0
EOF
sed -i '1s/^/import math\n\n/; s/from trailhead.elevation import gain_and_loss, highest_and_lowest/from trailhead.elevation import gain_and_loss, highest_and_lowest, steepest_grade/' tests/test_elevation.py
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
git diff src; git stash -q -- src && python -m pytest -q tests/test_elevation.py 2>&1 | tail -3; git stash pop -q && git status --short
